summary: On June 1, 2026, Oncolytics Biotech Inc. announced the appointment of John McAdory as Chief Operating Officer and Stephen Glover as a new director, disclosed in an 8-K filed June 2, 2026. Mr. McAdory will receive no additional compensation; Mr. Glover received an option for 96,000 shares at the June 1 closing price. No terms like stake, premium, or deal value are involved. Board recommendation or advisors are not named. This is a routine internal appointment, not a forced departure or external event. What to watch: any subsequent operational changes.
